title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer with at least 5 years of experience shipping production ML systems. You will design, train, and deploy models powering our personalization stack. The ideal candidate is fluent in Python and PyTorch, has hands-on experience with Transformers and HuggingFace, and has built or operated MLOps tooling. Bonus: experience with RAG pipelines, vector databases, and large language models.
